summary.text: Jorge Cabrera was elected in 2020 to represent Connecticut's 17th Senate District, which covers parts of Ansonia, Beacon Falls, Bethany, Derby, Hamden, Naugatuck and Woodbridge.

paragraphs.text: Cabrera graduated from Quinnipiac University in 1998 with a degree in Political Science and then worked for two years as a legislative aide to then-House Speaker Moira Lyons.

Cabrera later worked for the Carpenters Union and as an international representative for the United Food and Commercial Workers, and is a business representative and Director of Organizing for UFCW Local 919.
Cabrera lives in Hamden with his wife and their twin sons, according to the senator's official biography.
